profile.headline: Apparently Noogler is a real word that people actually use
profile.summary: Enthusiastic engineering manager with strong communication skills and a passion for debugging, leadership, and creative problem-solving.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
- Improved mobile compatibility of the online version of the Epocrates product.
 - Built web servers in Go and NodeJS that provided RESTful, FHIR-compliant APIs for accessing patient health information.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Created an internal tool for managing database schemas in development and production environments. The tool automatically generated complex SQL statements to update the schemas in the database to keep them in sync with a human-editable representation of the schemas.
 - Created a web application that contained a visual representation of our database schemas. This allowed users to easily understand and reference the database structure, including links between tables.
 - Created a deployment tool for SQL scripts in development and production environments.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Created a program to automatically geocode patent data from the United States Patent and Trademark Office.

projects.title: Geocoding Patent Data
projects.description: The United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) provides XML ﬁles containing information about all of the patents granted since 1976. Here, we examine the process required to geocode the patent data.

projects.title: Analyzing the Feasibility of Online Voting in U.S. Elections
projects.description: Honors thesis analyzing the system currently used to vote the US, reviewing the challenges involved in implementing an online voting system, and proposing a specific system that can be used to vote online with relative safety.
